name: Enduring Angel // Angelic Enforcer
oracle_text:
Flying, double strike
You have hexproof.
If your life total would be reduced to 0 or less, instead transform this creature and your life total becomes 3. Then if this creature didn't transform this way, you lose the game.
blocked_sentences: If your life total would be reduced to 0 or less, instead transform this creature and your life total becomes 3. Then if this creature didn't transform this way, you lose the game.

needs.what: a static replacement on its controller that fires whenever any life change (damage, life loss, paying life, setting life) would leave that player's life total at 0 or less: instead of that change, run an effect list on the source (here `transform` on self) and set the player's life total to a fixed value (3); then, if the source did not actually transform (e.g. it was already transformed or can't), that player loses the game
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `replace_life_loss` only multiplies a loss (`loss_multiplier`); `damage_life_floor` (static and op) only clamps damage to a floor of 1 and neither runs effects nor applies to life loss or payment; `lock_life_total` forbids any change; `cant_lose_the_game` prevents the loss outright. None replaces the reduction with a transform-plus-set-life and conditions a game loss on whether the transform happened
